assumptions.basis: Paper Table I bandwidth/capacity and 1800/100 GB/s fabrics; current NVIDIA HGX Rubin dense BF16 4 PFLOPS and FP32 130 TFLOPS supplement undisclosed paper compute. 60% compute efficiencies, 500 ns launch/link startup, 10 TB/s SRAM per stack, 1 ns SRAM, dedicated per-GPU NICs, uniform expert routing and balanced striped buffers are research assumptions, not paper measurements. No paper throughput is fitted.

precision.basis: Explicit BF16 research choice; not a dtype reported by the paper.

selection_scope: all discrete layouts screened; best of bounded closed-loop validations, not a proved global optimum
